entity.summary: Indonesian centralized cryptocurrency trading platform offering easy and advanced trading, portfolio management, and mobile access under PT Samuel Kripto Indonesia.
entity.notes: The current first-party corporate surface identifies PT Samuel Kripto Indonesia, describes an operating crypto exchange platform, states that the trading platform launched in 2022, and cites OJK licence KEP-8/D.07/2025. OJK's formal licence announcement grants PT Samuel Kripto Indonesia a Digital Financial Asset Trader business licence, while the current CFX member list records the brand as an exchange member. The former Vonix app identity is retained as an alias; no exact launch date is inferred beyond the reviewed launch year.
